address: 272 rue de la Mollard, Bossey, 74160, France
bio: The years pass, but this well-known establishment on the Franco-Swiss border continues to uphold time-honoured traditions, as the warm, elegant interior, gleaming silverware and polished service bear witness. The chef concocts impeccably presented, pedigree French cuisine overflowing in flavour: duck ravioli and foie gras, venison in bacon and a pepper sauce…...
